clips.title: The story
paras: At the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus records catastrophes for the Ironforge crown. A dwarven scholar serving King Magni Bronzebeard, she writes of recent calamities in the northern human kingdoms and oversees research into ancient dwarven tragedies, including the scorched remains of the Dark Iron kingdom.

Royal Historian Archesonus keeps Ironforge’s records near King Magni Bronzebeard’s throne in the High Seat. Her studies reach beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She wrote 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' and 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' tracing the Scourge’s ruin of humanity’s northern realm. Archesonus faces these dark histories with care, seeking to record the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse.

Royal Historian Archesonus also oversees research into the War of the Three Hammers and the destruction of Thaurissan. She seeks recovered relics and charred tablets from the Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes, and sends adventurers there to search. Her work examines the cataclysm that scorched the Burning Steppes and bound the Dark Iron clan to the Firelord.
